rules.why: A stock count of a part at a garage means the garage stocks it. The sheet states counts only; the link is what scheduling asks about.

then.flag: stock is at or below its reorder point: reorder

rules.why: The reorder point is set so a garage is never out of a part when a job needs it; East Garage ran out of BRK-221 during the Bus 4127 repair.

then.flag: an open work order uses a part its garage does not stock: the job waits on a transfer

rules.why: WO-2291 at East Garage needed BRK-221, which only Central Garage stocks; the bus waited for the transfer.
